title: A Ghost Tale for Christmas Time
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie travel to London in 1843 to cheer up a sad Charles Dickens — and inspire him to write A Christmas Carol! 🎻

q.en: In what year do Jack and Annie arrive to help Charles Dickens?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮是在哪一年来帮助查尔斯·狄更斯的？

options.en: In 1904, when the Abbey Theatre opened

explain.en: Jack figures it out: Dickens was born in 1812, Queen Victoria had been queen for six years (she came to the throne in 1837), so the year is 1843 — when Dickens is thirty-one.
explain.zh: 杰克推算出来了：狄更斯生于1812年，维多利亚女王已经登基六年（她1837年即位），所以这一年是1843年——狄更斯三十一岁。

q.en: What magic instrument do Kathleen and Teddy give them for this mission?
q.zh: 这次任务中，凯瑟琳和泰迪交给他们的魔法乐器是什么？

options.zh: 一支魔法风笛，那是别人讲的版本

explain.en: Kathleen tosses the magic Irish whistle into the air; it spins and becomes a small violin and bow — a magic violin that Jack plays while Annie sings.
explain.zh: 凯瑟琳把魔法爱尔兰哨笛抛向空中，它旋转之后变成了一把小提琴和琴弓——杰克拉琴、安妮唱歌的魔法小提琴。

q.en: Where does Charles Dickens live in London?
q.zh: 查尔斯·狄更斯住在伦敦的什么地方？

options.en: A large red-brick mansion on the edge of the Thames River
options.zh: 泰晤士河边一座红砖大宅，发生在很久很久以前

options.en: One Devonshire Terrace, below Regent's Park
options.zh: 摄政公园旁的一栋德文郡台宅

explain.en: A woman in the park tells Jack and Annie that Charles Dickens and his family live at One Devonshire Terrace, below Regent's Park, and the cab driver takes them there.
explain.zh: 公园里一位女士告诉杰克和安妮，查尔斯·狄更斯一家住在摄政公园旁的“德文郡台一号”，马车夫也把他们送到了那里。

q.en: What are the names of the two real chimney sweeps who trade clothes with Jack and Annie?
q.zh: 和杰克、安妮交换衣服的两个真正的小烟囱工叫什么名字？

options.en: Two boys named Willy and Finvara
options.zh: 两个叫威利和芬瓦拉的男孩

explain.en: The bigger boy wears an old top hat and is called Harry; the smaller boy wears a too-big wool cap and is called Colin. They trade their ragged coats, caps, and shoes for Jack and Annie's fine clothes.
explain.zh: 大一点的男孩戴着旧高帽，叫哈里；小一点的男孩戴着一顶太大的羊毛帽，叫科林。他们用自己破旧的衣服、帽子和鞋换走了杰克和安妮的体面行头。

q.en: Which of Dickens's books has a scene just like Jack and Annie's 'Stop, thief!' chase?
q.zh: 狄更斯的哪本书里，有一个和杰克、安妮“抓小偷！”的追逐一模一样的情节？

explain.en: Charles says their adventure is 'exactly like a scene in my book Oliver Twist!' In it, Oliver is wrongly accused of picking a pocket, and the real thieves lead the chase yelling 'Stop, thief!'
explain.zh: 查尔斯说他们的遭遇“和我书里《雾都孤儿》的情节一模一样！”书里奥利弗被冤枉偷了老人的东西，而真正的小偷带头追着喊“抓小偷！”。

q.en: What three ghosts does Annie's magic song bring to Charles?
q.zh: 安妮的魔法之歌为查尔斯唤来了哪三个幽灵？

options.en: The Ghosts of Christmas Yesterday, Today, and Tomorrow, as told by the Queen
options.zh: 女王讲述的圣诞昨天、今天和明天的幽灵

options.en: The Ghosts of Easter, Halloween, and New Year's Eve
options.zh: 复活节、万圣节和除夕的幽灵

options.en: The Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present, and Future
options.zh: 圣诞过去、现在和未来的幽灵

options.en: The Ghosts of Hope, Joy, and Sorrow
options.zh: 希望、欢乐和忧伤的幽灵

explain.en: Annie sings a version of A Christmas Carol and the Ghost of Christmas Past, the Ghost of Christmas Present, and the Ghost of Christmas Future appear to Charles, just like in his own story.
explain.zh: 安妮唱了一版《圣诞颂歌》，圣诞过去之灵、现在之灵和未来之灵出现在查尔斯面前，正像他自己的故事里那样。

q.en: At what age did Charles Dickens work in a shoe polish factory?
q.zh: 查尔斯·狄更斯几岁时在鞋油工厂做工？

explain.en: Charles tells Jack and Annie that when he was twelve he worked eleven hours a day, six days a week, pasting labels on pots of black shoe polish, and lived alone after his father went to a debtors' prison.
explain.zh: 查尔斯告诉杰克和安妮，他十二岁时每天干十一个小时、一周干六天，给黑鞋油的罐子贴标签，父亲进了债务监狱后他便独自生活。

q.en: What book did the young Charles love to read, the one with the flying carpet?
q.zh: 小时候的查尔斯最爱读哪本书——就是那本有飞毯的书？

options.en: A book of poems by William Shakespeare

explain.en: The Ghost of Christmas Past shows Charles as a small boy reading a book with a picture of a flying carpet — The Arabian Nights, which gave him hope when he had none.
explain.zh: 圣诞过去之灵让查尔斯看到小时候的自己，正读着一本封面画着飞毯的书——《一千零一夜》，那本书在他毫无希望时给了他力量。

q.en: What name does Annie suggest for the greedy, selfish character in Charles's new story?
q.zh: 安妮给查尔斯新故事里那个贪婪自私的角色起了什么名字？

explain.en: Charles says he'll write about a greedy man 'like Mr. Pinch' (the stingy innkeeper), but Annie suggests 'Scrooge,' and Charles loves it.
explain.zh: 查尔斯说要写一个像“平奇先生”（那个吝啬的旅馆老板）一样贪婪的人，安妮建议叫“斯克鲁奇”，查尔斯非常喜欢这个名字。

q.en: What does Charles decide to call his Christmas ghost story?
q.zh: 查尔斯决定给他的圣诞幽灵故事起什么名字？

explain.en: Charles plans a story about a man changed by three ghosts. Jack suggests 'A Christmas Carol,' and Charles adds the subtitle 'Being a Ghost Story of Christmas.'
explain.zh: 查尔斯打算写一个被三个幽灵改变的人物的故事。杰克提议叫《圣诞颂歌》，查尔斯又加上副标题“一则圣诞幽灵故事”。
